items.headline: Hi, I'm
items.intro: I build and improve user-focused software, with interests in accessibility, responsible AI research, and thoughtful design. Outside of code, I enjoy photography.
items.card_body: Exploring personal AI with ChatGPT while contributing to software and research projects.

items.body: I'm Than Bannarat , a senior Computer Science student at Arizona State University , with an expected graduation date of May 2027 . I also earned an Associate of Science in Computer Science from Mesa Community College in May 2025.

My experience spans Java application development, accessibility-focused front-end work, and research into how large language models make privacy-related decisions. I enjoy creating useful, understandable experiences and improving them through testing and iteration.
I'm also working on a personal AI project with ChatGPT . It's still in progress, so I'll share implementation details and demos once they're ready.
